description: Paid ($0.01 via x402 in USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, or in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger): for expensive calls. The pre-payment verdict (go, caution or no_go) plus the full diagnosis, the 30-day history per day, how reliable the seller's other endpoints are and whether the endpoint moved domains. Never pays the endpoint. Worth it before a payment above about $1; for an ordinary call x402_preflight is enough. Same as GET /api/v1/preflight/deep. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.

body.description: Example JSON request body, for a POST route that checks its input before the 402 (implies POST). Without it, {} is sent and the requestBody example in the endpoint's /openapi.json is tried.

client.description: Set to gateway when your agent pays with Circle's Gateway client (@circle-fin/x402-batching) from a Gateway balance: Gateway-only endpoints are then not a caution, and Gateway options are recommended first.

max_usd.description: Your budget per call in USD, e.g. 0.5

method.description: HTTP method of the paid route (default: GET, then POST)

network.description: CAIP-2 network you want to pay on, e.g. eip155:8453

url.description: The x402 endpoint (public http(s) URL), e.g. https://api.example.com/paid

name: x402_preflight_deep

accepts.description: Only on an unpaid call: the x402 payment options

receipt.description: Signed receipt (EIP-191) binding the answer to your arguments

anyOf.description: go: pay; caution: ask first; no_go: do not pay

title: Deep check of an x402 endpoint before an expensive payment ($0.01 via x402)
